sentence: After opening the main menu, clicking an empty part of the canvas closes the menu.
setup: Click the main menu button (three lines, top left) so the menu opens.
ready: the main menu is open and shows its items
action: Click once on an empty part of the canvas, near the bottom middle of the page, away from the menu and from any button. Then wait 2 seconds. Do not press Escape and do not click the menu button again.
broken: The main menu (a panel at the top left listing items such as Save to, Export image and Preferences) is open.
working: The main menu (a panel at the top left listing items such as Save to, Export image and Preferences) is closed.
title: fix(editor): dismiss dropdown menus on outside clicks
